name: Vitesse
notes: Only Anthony Fu's repo is canonical. hamlim/vitesse-ghostty-theme, colinlienard/zed-vitesse-theme-refined and rafaeldellaquila/zsh-vitesse-theme were used as examples only.
Defaults to the soft pair because that's what Zed is set to (Vitesse Refined Soft).
upstream scripts/colors.ts defines a `decorator` color (#bd8f8f) that the generated theme never uses; decorators resolve to the function color, as they appear in VS Code.
Vitesse's palette in scripts/colors.ts has no separate class/interface token rules; those come from semanticTokenColors, which the palette reads.
Vitesse Black is left out; add upstream/vitesse-black.json and a variant to include it.
